summary: The hostname module sets the system hostname on most OSes including systemd ones, but not Windows, HP-UX or AIX. It does not edit /etc/hosts, and on macOS sets several names via scutil.
questions: How do I change a server's hostname with Ansible?
Can I set hostnames on Windows with this module?
How does hostname work on macOS?

answer_card.title: Set hostname
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.hostname` sets the hostname on most OSes (incl. systemd). Not Windows, HP-UX, AIX.

It does **not** modify `/etc/hosts`; manage that with `template`/`replace`/`lineinfile`. On macOS it sets `HostName`, `ComputerName` and `LocalHostName` (special chars replaced).
